name: 3-methyl-6-[3-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl]-[1,2,4]triazolo[4,3-b]pyridazine
summary: CL-218,872 is a sedative and hypnotic drug used in scientific research. It has similar effects to sedative-hypnotic benzodiazepine drugs such as triazolam, but is structurally distinct and so is classed as a nonbenzodiazepine hypnotic.

pharmacology.text: CL-218,872 is a GABAA partial agonist which is selective for the α1 subtype.

uses.text: CL-218,872 is a sedative and hypnotic drug used in scientific research.

fact.en: CL-218,872 was one of the first drugs found to prefer the alpha-1 type of GABA-A receptor, the same type targeted by the sleep medicine zolpidem. This helped scientists see that benzodiazepine receptors come in different types.
fact.zh: CL-218,872 是最早被發現偏好 α1 型 GABA-A 受體的藥物之一，安眠藥佐沛眠也是作用於這一型。這幫助科學家了解到苯二氮平受體有不同的類型。
fact.zhHans: CL-218,872 是最早被发现偏好 α1 型 GABA-A 受体的药物之一，安眠药佐沛眠也是作用于这一型。这帮助科学家了解到苯二氮平受体有不同的类型。
